findings.text: follow-on: the checkpoint names the unfinished chunk as the fifth while the tests line at line 11 and the gate logs (base-chunk02.log and head-chunk02.log, the only logs with no EXIT line) name chunk02, so the two fields disagree about which chunk's delta is unstated.

follow-on: `_stream_reading_refusal` returns None whenever the newest stream is not in motion, so for a run on another host with an unknown liveness and a stream carrying no assistant turn `_launcher_refusal` returns None while `_observed_end_refusal` refuses the missing end; production is unaffected because the manifest records both are consulted at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1829-1831, but the prediction helper still does not fully mirror the launcher's end gate.

follow-on: the landing commit 49d7b6d5b body claims it adds the gate figure, but no figure landed and docs/figures/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/ does not exist, so a reader following the commit message for a figure finds none.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: af04316ea extracts `_observed_process_reading` from `_observed_end_refusal`'s inline fold and adds `_stream_reading_refusal`, wiring both doors through them, and 49d7b6d5b adds the landing fragment; the extraction preserves `_observed_end_refusal`'s semantics and adds only the stream-reading refusal to `_launcher_refusal`.
item_verdicts.done_when: section 17's done-when names a parity case in tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py for another host's pid with a stream moving inside the stall window, both doors refusing, and both proceeding past the window; the manifest records that case and I re-ran the file at head and saw 8 passed, matching the manifest's 8-against-7.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that `_launcher_refusal` applies the same stream reading `_observed_end_refusal` applies, through one shared helper rather than a copy, so a dry run predicts the refusal the launcher makes; at reckon/crew/resumption.py:981 the prediction now returns `_stream_reading_refusal(record, reading=_observed_process_reading(record))`, and `_observed_end_refusal` consults the same two helpers at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1076-1081.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the parity case, the negative control and a five-chunk gate over the 37 importing test files, and it reports the unfinished chunk rather than a finished one, though its checkpoint line names the fifth chunk while its tests line and the gate logs name chunk02.
item_verdicts.write_paths: section 17 names reckon/crew/resumption.py and tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py, and the manifest adds the landing fragment; the diff d68b2d592..49d7b6d5b changes exactly those two code files plus docs/evidence/fragments/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/a-dry-run-resume-predicts-the-stream-reading.html, every path inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: the recorded negative control reddens the added case (negative-control.log fails at tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py:228), and the added assertions hold the prediction's verdict against `_observed_end_refusal`'s independent one rather than a value the test passed in.
justifications.evidence: the parity case and its negative control reproduce at tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py:207, but the done-when's same-pass-and-fail-ids clause is unstated for one gate chunk, since base-chunk02.log and head-chunk02.log carry no EXIT line.
justifications.fit: the two added helpers follow the mechanism-named, long-docstring idiom of reckon/crew/resumption.py:984.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/resumption.py:981 makes the prediction return the same `_stream_reading_refusal` the launcher's `_observed_end_refusal` consults at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1080, so the two doors cannot disagree about the stream.
justifications.reuse: `_observed_process_reading` extracts `_observed_end_refusal`'s own inline fold rather than forking it, and both helpers stand on the existing owners `_process_reading` and `_newest_stream_in_motion` in reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the paths the manifest declares.
